fieldValues.title: Draft the RFC requests
fieldValues.description: Take the first RFC request from clerk queue --rfcs, only when no Draft of yours waits for the owner: claim as the RFC drafter, check whether a ruling already decides it, run the srs RFC procedure Stages 0 to 4 without pausing, open the Draft PR at owner merge, run report. Never accepts, folds or merges (778f154a).
fieldValues.done_when: Each RFC request taken has a reviewed Draft RFC PR waiting for the owner, or a comment naming the ruling that already decides it.
fieldValues.trigger: every 6 hours at :25 (RFC drafter, every 6 hours)
fieldValues.size: One RFC request per run; one Draft waiting at a time
